verdict.rationale: Obsidian's version history (obsidian-docs-28, obsidian-docs-37) applies to individual notes, not to plugins/templates/scripts that constitute 'automations'; the Git plugin is mentioned only as a community-added backup tool (obsidian-comm-8), not a first-party review/rollback system for automations. No evidence shows a mechanism to version, review, or roll back plugin configurations, Templater scripts, or other automation logic.
